```
the pool of 799 cards needs 2465 seeds past super.yml's 10000, over the 300 this test plays: a person must widen FUZZ_SEEDS in .github/workflows/super.yml to at least 12465 (and check its fuzz job's shards and timeout)
```

Done means super.yml's `FUZZ_SEEDS` covers the 799-card pool (`daily_seeds(799)` = ceil(780 × 799 / 50) = 12,465). The test then returns before playing anything, and the docs that name the daily count say the new one.

- **Little headroom.** 12,500 covers a pool of up to 801 cards. Up to about 820 cards (12,800 seeds), the daily test plays the rest itself, at most 300 seeds. Past that it fails again with the same message, naming the new minimum. See Open questions.
